17.16: and if he wash not, and his flesh bathe not--then he has borne his iniquity.'

18.1: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
18.2: `Speak to the sons of Israel, and you have said to them, I am Jehovah your God;
18.3: according to the work of the land of Egypt in which you have dwelt you do not, and according to the work of the land of Canaan where I am bringing you in, you do not, and in their statutes you walk not.
18.4: `My judgments you do, and My statutes you keep, to walk in them; I am Jehovah your God;
18.5: and you have kept My statutes and My judgments which man does and lives in them; I am Jehovah.
18.6: `None of you to any relation of his flesh does draw near to uncover nakedness; I am Jehovah.
18.7: `The nakedness of your father and the nakedness of your mother you do not uncover, she is your mother; you do not uncover her nakedness.
18.8: `The nakedness of the wife of your father you do not uncover; it is the nakedness of your father.
18.9: `The nakedness of your sister, daughter of your father, or daughter of your mother, born at home or born without; you do not uncover their nakedness.
18.10: `The nakedness of your son's daughter, or of your daughter's daughter: you do not uncover their nakedness; for theirs is your nakedness.
18.11: `The nakedness of a daughter of your father's wife, begotten of your father, she is your sister; you do not uncover her nakedness.
18.12: `The nakedness of a sister of your father you do not uncover; she is a relation of your father.
18.13: `The nakedness of your mother's sister you do not uncover; for she is your mother's relation.
18.14: `The nakedness of your father's brother you do not uncover; to his wife you do not draw near; she is yours aunt.
18.15: `The nakedness of your daughter-in-law you do not uncover; she is your son's wife; you do not uncover her nakedness.
18.16: `The nakedness of your brother's wife you do not uncover; it is your brother's nakedness.
18.17: `The nakedness of a woman and her daughter you do not uncover; her son's daughter, and her daughter's daughter you do not take to uncover her nakedness; they are her relations; it is wickedness.
18.18: `And a woman to another you do not take, to be an adversary, to uncover her nakedness beside her, in her life.
18.19: `And to a woman in the separation of her uncleanness you do not draw near to uncover her nakedness.
18.20: `And to the wife of your fellow you do not give your seed of copulation, for uncleanness with her.
18.21: `And of your seed you do not give to pass over to the Molech; nor do you pollute the name of your God; I am Jehovah.
18.22: `And with a male you do not lie as one lies with a woman; abomination it is.
18.23: `And with any beast you do not give your copulation, for uncleanness with it; and a woman does not stand before a beast to lie down with it; confusion it is.
18.24: `You are not defiled with all these, for with all these have the nations been defiled which I am sending away from before you;
18.25: and the land is defiled, and I charge its iniquity upon it, and the land vomits out its inhabitants:
18.26: and you--you have kept My statutes and My judgments, and do not any of all these abominations, the native and the sojourner who is sojourning in your midst,
18.27: (for all these abominations have the men of the land done who are before you, and the land is defiled),
18.28: and the land does not vomit you out in your defiling it, as it has vomited out the nation which is before you;
18.29: for any one who does any of all these abominations--even the persons who are doing so, have been cut off from the midst of their people;
18.30: and you have kept My charge, so as not to do any of the abominable statutes which have been done before you, and you do not defile yourselves with them; I am Jehovah your God.'

19.1: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
19.2: `Speak to all the company of the sons of Israel, and you have said to them, You are holy, for holy am I, Jehovah, your God.
19.3: `Each his mother and his father you do fear, and My sabbaths you do keep; I am Jehovah your God.
19.4: `You do not turn to the idols, and a molten god you do not make to yourselves; I am Jehovah your God.
19.5: `And when you sacrifice a sacrifice of peace-offerings to Jehovah, at your pleasure you do sacrifice it;
19.6: in the day of your sacrificing it is eaten, and on the morrow, and that which is left to the third day with fire is burnt,
19.7: and if it be really eaten on the third day, it is an abomination, it is not pleasing,
19.8: and he who is eating it his iniquity does bear, for the holy thing of Jehovah he has polluted, and that person has been cut off from his people.
19.9: `And in your reaping the harvest of your land you do not completely reap the corner of your field, and the gleaning of your harvest you do not gather,
19.10: and your vineyard you do not glean, even the omitted part of your vineyard you do not gather, to the poor and to the sojourner you do leave them; I am Jehovah your God.
19.11: `You do not steal, nor feign, nor lie one against his fellow.
19.12: `And you do not swear by My name to falsehood, or you have polluted the name of your God; I am Jehovah.
19.13: `You do not oppress your neighbour, nor take plunder; the wages of the hireling does not remain with you till morning.
19.14: `You do not revile the deaf; and before the blind you do not put a stumbling block; and you have been afraid of your God; I am Jehovah.
19.15: `You do not do perversity in judgment; you do not lift up the face of the poor, nor honour the face of the great; in righteousness you do judge your fellow.
19.16: `You do not go slandering among your people; you do not stand against the blood of your neighbour; I am Jehovah.
19.17: `You do not hate your brother in your heart; you do certainly reprove your fellow, and not suffer sin on him.
19.18: `You do not take vengeance, nor watch the sons of your people; and you have had love to your neighbour as yourself; I am Jehovah.
19.19: `My statutes you do keep: your cattle you do not cause to gender with diverse kinds; your field you do not sow with diverse kinds, and a garment of diverse kinds, shaatnez, does not go up upon you.
19.20: `And when a man lies with a woman with seed of copulation, and she a maid-servant, betrothed to a man, and not really ransomed, or freedom has not been given to her, an investigation there is; they are not put to death, for she is not free.
19.21: `And he has brought in his guilt-offering to Jehovah, to the opening of the tent of meeting, a ram for a guilt-offering,
19.22: and the priest has made atonement for him with the ram of the guilt-offering before Jehovah, for his sin which he has sinned, and it has been forgiven him because of his sin which he has sinned.
19.23: `And when you come in to the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you have reckoned as uncircumcised its fruit, three years it is to you uncircumcised, it is not eaten,
19.24: and in the fourth year all its fruit is holy--praises for Jehovah.
19.25: And in the fifth year you do eat its fruit--to add to you its increase; I am Jehovah your God.
19.26: `You do not eat with the blood; you do not enchant, nor observe clouds.
19.27: `You do not round the corner of your head, nor destroy the corner of your beard.
19.28: `And a cutting for the soul you do not put in your flesh; and a writing, a cross-mark, you do not put on you; I am Jehovah.
19.29: `You do not pollute your daughter to cause her to go a-whoring, that the land go not a-whoring, and the land has been full of wickedness.
19.30: `My sabbaths you do keep, and My sanctuary you do reverence; I am Jehovah.
19.31: `You do not turn to those having familiar spirits; and to wizards you do not seek, for uncleanness by them; I am Jehovah your God.
19.32: `At the presence of grey hairs you do rise up, and you have honoured the presence of an old man, and have been afraid of your God; I am Jehovah.
19.33: `And when a sojourner sojourns with you in your land, you do not oppress him;
19.34: as a native among you is the sojourner to you who is sojourning with you, and you have had love to him as to yourself, for sojourners you have been in the land of Egypt; I am Jehovah your God.
19.35: `You do not do perversity in judgment, in mete-yard, in weight, or in liquid measure;
19.36: righteous balances, righteous weights, a righteous ephah, and a righteous hin you have; I am Jehovah your God, who has brought you out from the land of Egypt;
19.37: and you have observed all my statutes, and all my judgments, and have done them; I am Jehovah.'

20.1: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
20.2: `And to the sons of Israel you do say, Any man of the sons of Israel, and of the sojourners who is sojourning in Israel, who gives of his seed to the Molech, is certainly put to death; the people of the land do stone him with stones;
20.3: and I--I set My face against that man, and have cut him off from the midst of his people, for of his seed he has given to the Molech, so as to defile My sanctuary, and to pollute My holy name.
20.4: `And if the people of the land really hide their eyes from that man, in his giving of his seed to the Molech, so as not to put him to death,
20.5: then I have set My face against that man, and against his family, and have cut him off, and all who are going a-whoring after him, even going a-whoring after the Molech, from the midst of their people.
20.6: `And the person who turns to those having familiar spirits, and to the wizards, to go a-whoring after them, I have even set My face against that person, and cut him off from the midst of his people.
20.7: `And you have sanctified yourselves, and you have been holy, for I am Jehovah your God;
20.8: and you have kept My statutes and have done them; I am Jehovah, sanctifying you.
20.9: `For any man who reviles his father and his mother is certainly put to death; his father and his mother he has reviled: his blood is on him.
20.10: `And a man who commits adultery with a man's wife--who commits adultery with the wife of his neighbour--the adulterer and the adulteress are surely put to death.
20.11: `And a man who lies with his father's wife--the nakedness of his father he has uncovered--both of them are certainly put to death; their blood is on them.
20.12: `And a man who lies with his daughter-in-law--both of them are certainly put to death; confusion they have made; their blood is on them.
20.13: `And a man who lies with a male as one lies with a woman; abomination both of them have done; they are certainly put to death; their blood is on them.
20.14: `And a man who takes the woman and her mother--it is wickedness; with fire they burn him and them, and there is no wickedness in your midst.
20.15: `And a man who gives his lying with a beast is certainly put to death, and the beast you do slay.
20.16: `And a woman who draws near to any beast to lie with it--you have even slain the woman and the beast; they are certainly put to death; their blood is on them.
20.17: `And a man who takes his sister, a daughter of his father or daughter of his mother, and he has seen her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness: it is a shame; and they have been cut off before the eyes of the sons of their people; the nakedness of his sister he has uncovered; his iniquity he bears.
20.18: `And a man who lies with a sick woman, and has uncovered her nakedness, her fountain he has made bare, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood, --even both of them have been cut off from the midst of their people.
20.19: `And the nakedness of your mother's sister, and of your father's sister, you do not uncover; because his relation he has made bare; their iniquity they bear.
20.20: `And a man who lies with his aunt, the nakedness of his uncle he has uncovered; their sin they bear; childless they die.
20.21: `And a man who takes his brother's wife--it is impurity; the nakedness of his brother he has uncovered; childless they are.
20.22: `And you have kept all My statutes, and all My judgments, and have done them, and the land vomits you not out where I am bringing you in to dwell in it;
20.23: and you walk not in the statutes of the nation which I am sending away from before you, for all these they have done, and I am wearied with them;
20.24: and I say to you, You--you do possess their ground, and I--I give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey; I am Jehovah your God, who has separated you from the peoples.
20.25: `And you have made separation between the pure beasts and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the pure, and you do not make yourselves abominable by beast or by fowl, or by anything which creeps on the ground which I have separated to you for unclean;
20.26: and you have been holy to Me; for holy am I, Jehovah; and I separate you from the peoples to become Mine.
20.27: `And a man or woman--when there is in them a familiar spirit, or who are wizards--are certainly put to death; with stones they stone them; their blood is on them.'

21.1: And Jehovah says to Moses, `Speak to the priests, sons of Aaron, and you have said to them, For any person a priest is not defiled among his people,
21.2: except for his relation who is near to him--for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother.
21.3: and for his sister, the virgin, who is near to him, who has not been to a man; for her he is defiled.
21.4: `A master priest does not defile himself among his people--to pollute himself;
21.5: they do not make baldness on their head, and the corner of their beard they do not shave, and in their flesh they do not make a cutting;
21.6: they are holy to their God, and they pollute not the name of their God, for the fire-offerings of Jehovah, bread of their God, they are bringing near, and have been holy.
21.7: `A woman, a harlot, or polluted, they do not take, and a woman cast out from her husband they do not take, for he is holy to his God;
21.8: and you have sanctified him, for the bread of your God he is bringing near; he is holy to you; for holy am I, Jehovah, sanctifying you.
21.9: `And a daughter of any priest when she pollutes herself by going a-whoring--her father she is polluting; with fire she is burnt.
21.10: `And the high priest of his brethren, on whose head is poured the anointing oil, and has consecrated his hand to put on the garments, his head does not uncover, nor rend his garments,
21.11: nor beside any dead person does he come; for his father and for his mother he does not defile himself;
21.12: nor from the sanctuary does he go out, nor does he pollute the sanctuary of his God, for the separation of the anointing oil of his God is on him; I am Jehovah.
21.13: `And he takes a wife in her virginity;
21.14: widow, or cast out, or polluted one--a harlot--these he does not take, but a virgin of his own people he does take for a wife,
21.15: and he does not pollute his seed among his people; for I am Jehovah, sanctifying him.'
21.16: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
21.17: `Speak to Aaron, saying, No man of your seed to their generations in whom there is blemish does draw near to bring near the bread of his God,
21.18: for no man in whom is blemish does draw near--a man blind, or lame or dwarfed, or enlarged,
21.19: or a man in whom there is a breach in the foot, or a breach in the hand,
21.20: or hump-backed, or a dwarf, or with a mixture in his eye, or a scurvy person, or scabbed, or broken-testicled.
21.21: `No man in whom is blemish (of the seed of Aaron the priest) does come nigh to bring near the fire-offerings of Jehovah; blemish is in him; the bread of his God he does not come nigh to bring near.
21.22: `Bread of his God--of the most holy things, and of the holy things--he does eat;
21.23: only, to the vail he does not enter, and to the altar he does not draw nigh; for blemish is in him; and he does not pollute My sanctuaries; for I am Jehovah, sanctifying them.'
21.24: And Moses speaks to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the sons of Israel.

22.1: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
22.2: `Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and they are separated from the holy things of the sons of Israel, and they pollute not My holy name in what they are hallowing to Me; I am Jehovah.
22.3: `Say to them, To your generations, any man who draws near, out of all your seed, to the holy things which the sons of Israel do sanctify to Jehovah, and his uncleanness on him--even that person has been cut off from before Me; I am Jehovah.
22.4: `Any man of the seed of Aaron, and is leprous or has an issue--of the holy things he does not eat till that he is clean; and he who is coming against any uncleanness of a person, or a man whose seed of copulation goes out from him,
22.5: or a man who comes against any teeming thing which is unclean to him, or against a man who is unclean to him, even any of his uncleanness--
22.6: the person who comes against it--has even been unclean till the evening, and does not eat of the holy things, but has bathed his flesh with water,
22.7: and the sun has gone in, and he has been clean, and afterwards he does eat of the holy things, for it is his food;
22.8: a carcase or torn thing he does not eat, for uncleanness thereby; I am Jehovah.
22.9: `And they have kept My charge, and bear no sin for it, that they have died for it when they pollute it; I am Jehovah sanctifying them.
22.10: `And no stranger does eat of the holy thing; a settler of a priest and an hireling does not eat of the holy thing;
22.11: and when a priest buys a person, the purchase of his money, he does eat of it, also one born in his house; they do eat of his bread.
22.12: `And a priest's daughter, when she is a strange man's, --she, of the heave-offering of the holy things does not eat;
22.13: and a priest's daughter, when she is a widow, or cast out, and has no seed, and has turned back to the house of her father, as in her youth, of her father's bread she does eat; but no stranger does eat of it.
22.14: `And when a man does eat of a holy thing through ignorance, then he has added its fifth part to it, and has given it to the priest, with the holy thing;
22.15: and they do not pollute the holy things of the sons of Israel--that which they lift up to Jehovah,
22.16: nor have caused them to bear the iniquity of the guilt-offering in their eating their holy things; for I am Jehovah, sanctifying them.'
22.17: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
22.18: `Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the sons of Israel, and you have said to them, Any man of the house of Israel, or of the sojourners in Israel, who brings near his offering, of all his vows, or of all his willing offerings which they bring near to Jehovah for a burnt-offering;
22.19: at your pleasure a perfect one, a male of the herd, of the sheep or of the goats;
22.20: nothing in which is blemish do you bring near, for it is not for a pleasing thing for you.
22.21: `And when a man brings near a sacrifice of peace-offerings to Jehovah, to complete a vow, or for a willing-offering, of the herd or of the flock, it is perfect for a pleasing thing: no blemish is in it;
22.22: blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed--you do not bring these near to Jehovah, and a fire-offering you do not make of them on the altar to Jehovah.
22.23: `As to an ox or a sheep enlarged or dwarfed--a willing-offering you do make it, but for a vow it is not pleasing.
22.24: As to a bruised, or beaten, or enlarged, or cut thing--you do not bring it near to Jehovah; even in your land you do not do it.
22.25: And from the hand of a son of a stranger you do not bring near the bread of your God, of any of these, for their corruption is in them; blemish is in them; they are not pleasing for you.'
22.26: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
22.27: `When ox or lamb or goat is born, and it has been seven days under its dam, then from the eighth day and now, it is pleasing for an offering, a fire-offering to Jehovah;
22.28: but an ox or sheep--it and its young one, you do not slaughter in one day.
22.29: `And when you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to Jehovah, at your pleasure you do sacrifice,
22.30: on that day it is eaten, you do not leave of it till morning; I am Jehovah;
22.31: and you have kept my commands, and have done them; I am Jehovah;
22.32: and you do not pollute My holy name, and I have been hallowed in the midst of the sons of Israel; I am Jehovah, sanctifying you,
22.33: who am bringing you up out of the land of Egypt, to become your God; I am Jehovah.'

23.1: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
23.2: `Speak to the sons of Israel, and you have said to them, Appointed seasons of Jehovah, which you proclaim, holy convocations, are these: they are My appointed seasons:
23.3: six days is work done, and in the seventh day is a sabbath of rest, a holy convocation; you do no work; it is a sabbath to Jehovah in all your dwellings.
23.4: `These are appointed seasons of Jehovah, holy convocations, which you proclaim in their appointed seasons:
23.5: in the first month, on the fourteenth of the month, between the evenings, is the passover to Jehovah;
23.6: and on the fifteenth day of this month is the feast of unleavened things to Jehovah; seven days unleavened things you do eat;
23.7: on the first day you have a holy convocation, you do no servile work;
23.8: and you have brought near a fire-offering to Jehovah seven days; in the seventh day is a holy convocation; you do no servile work.'
23.9: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
23.10: `Speak to the sons of Israel, and you have said to them, When you come in to the land which I am giving to you, and have reaped its harvest, and have brought in the sheaf, the beginning of your harvest to the priest,
23.11: then he has waved the sheaf before Jehovah for your acceptance; on the morrow of the sabbath does the priest wave it.
23.12: `And you have prepared in the day of your waving the sheaf a lamb, a perfect one, a son of a year, for a burnt-offering to Jehovah,
23.13: and its present two tenth deals of flour mixed with oil, a fire-offering to Jehovah, a sweet fragrance, and its drink-offering, wine, a fourth of the hin.
23.14: `And bread and roasted corn and full ears you do not eat until this self-same day, until your bringing in the offering of your God--a statute age-during to your generations, in all your dwellings.
23.15: `And you have numbered to you from the morrow of the sabbath, from the day of your bringing in the sheaf of the wave-offering: they are seven perfect sabbaths;
23.16: to the morrow of the seventh sabbath you do number fifty days, and you have brought near a new present to Jehovah;
23.17: out of your dwellings you bring in bread of a wave-offering, two loaves, of two tenth deals of flour they are, with yeast they are baken, first- fruits to Jehovah.
23.18: `And you have brought near, besides the bread, seven lambs, perfect ones, sons of a year, and one bullock, a son of the herd, and two rams; they are a burnt-offering to Jehovah, with their present and their libations, a fire-offering of sweet fragrance to Jehovah.
23.19: `And you have prepared one kid of the goats for a sin-offering, and two lambs, sons of a year, for a sacrifice of peace-offerings,
23.20: and the priest has waved them, besides the bread of the first- fruits --a wave-offering before Jehovah, besides the two lambs; they are holy to Jehovah for the priest;
23.21: and you have proclaimed on this self-same day: a holy convocation is to you, you do no servile work--a statute age-during in all your dwellings, to your generations.
23.22: `And in your reaping the harvest of your land you do not complete the corner of your field in your reaping, and the gleaning of your harvest you do not gather, to the poor and to the sojourner you do leave them; I Jehovah am your God.'
23.23: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
23.24: `Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, on the first of the month, you have a sabbath, a memorial of shouting, a holy convocation;
23.25: you do no servile work, and you have brought near a fire-offering to Jehovah.'
23.26: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
23.27: `Only--on the tenth of this seventh month is a day of atonements; you have a holy convocation, and you have humbled yourselves, and have brought near a fire-offering to Jehovah;
23.28: and you do no work in this self-same day, for it is a day of atonements, to make atonement for you, before Jehovah your God.
23.29: `For any person who is not humbled in this self-same day has even been cut off from his people;
23.30: and any person who does any work in this self-same day I have even destroyed that person from the midst of his people;
23.31: you do no work--a statute age-during to your generations in all your dwellings.
23.32: It is a sabbath of rest to you, and you have humbled yourselves in the ninth of the month at even; from evening till evening you do keep your sabbath.'
23.33: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
23.34: `Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, In the fifteenth day of this seventh month is a feast of booths seven days to Jehovah;
23.35: on the first day is a holy convocation, you do no servile work,
23.36: seven days you bring near a fire-offering to Jehovah, on the eighth day you have a holy convocation, and you have brought near a fire-offering to Jehovah; it is a restraint, you do no servile work.
23.37: `These are appointed seasons of Jehovah, which you proclaim holy convocations, to bring near a fire-offering to Jehovah, a burnt-offering, and a present, a sacrifice, and libations, a thing of a day in its day,
23.38: apart from the sabbaths of Jehovah, and apart from your gifts, and apart from all your vows, and apart from all your willing-offerings, which you give to Jehovah.
23.39: `Only--in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, in your gathering the increase of the land, you do keep the feast of Jehovah seven days; on the first day is a sabbath, and on the eighth day a sabbath;
23.40: and you have taken to yourselves on the first day the fruit of beautiful trees, branches of palms, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of a brook, and have rejoiced before Jehovah your God seven days.
23.41: `And you have kept it a feast to Jehovah, seven days in a year--a statute age-during to your generations; in the seventh month you keep it a feast.
23.42: `In booths you dwell seven days; all who are natives in Israel dwell in booths,
23.43: so that your generations do know that in booths I caused the sons of Israel to dwell; in my bringing them out of the land of Egypt; I, Jehovah, am your God.'
23.44: And Moses speaks concerning the appointed seasons of Jehovah to the sons of Israel.

24.1: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
24.2: `Command the sons of Israel, and they bring to you pure olive oil, beaten, for the lamp, to cause a light to go up continually;
24.3: at the outside of the vail of the testimony in the tent of meeting does Aaron arrange it from evening till morning before Jehovah continually--a statute age-during to your generations;
24.4: by the pure candlestick he does arrange the lights before Jehovah continually.
24.5: `And you have taken flour, and have baked twelve cakes with it, two tenth deals are in the one cake,
24.6: and you have set them two ranks (six in the rank) on the pure table before Jehovah,
24.7: and you have put on the rank pure frankincense, and it has been to the bread for a memorial, a fire-offering to Jehovah.
24.8: `On each sabbath-day he arranges it before Jehovah continually, from the sons of Israel--a covenant age-during;
24.9: and it has been to Aaron, and to his sons, and they have eaten it in the holy place, for it is most holy to him, from the fire-offerings of Jehovah--a statute age-during.'
24.10: And a son of an Israelitish woman goes out (and he is son of an Egyptian man), in the midst of the sons of Israel, and strive in the camp do the son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel,
24.11: and the son of the Israelitish woman execrateth the Name, and reviles; and they bring him in to Moses; and his mother's name is Shelomith daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan;
24.12: and he causes him to rest in charge--to explain to them by the mouth of Jehovah.
24.13: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
24.14: `Bring out the reviler to the outside of the camp; and all those hearing have laid their hands on his head, and all the company have stoned him.
24.15: `And to the sons of Israel you do speak, saying, When any man reviles his God--then he has borne his sin;
24.16: and he who is execrating the name of Jehovah is certainly put to death; all the company do certainly cast stones at him; as a sojourner so a native, in his execrating the Name, is put to death.
24.17: `And when a man smites any soul of man, he is certainly put to death.
24.18: `And he who smites a beast repays it, body for body.
24.19: `And when a man puts a blemish in his fellow, as he has done so it is done to him;
24.20: breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; as he puts a blemish in a man so it is done in him.
24.21: `And he who smites a beast repays it, and he who smites the life of man is put to death;
24.22: one judgment is to you; as a sojourner so is a native; for I am Jehovah your God.'
24.23: And Moses speaks to the sons of Israel, and they bring out the reviler to the outside of the camp, and stone him with stones; and the sons of Israel have done as Jehovah has commanded Moses.

25.1: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, in mount Sinai, saying,
25.2: `Speak to the sons of Israel, and you have said to them, When you come in to the land which I am giving to you, then has the land kept a sabbath to Jehovah.
25.3: `Six years you do sow your field, and six years you do prune your vineyard, and have gathered its increase,
25.4: and in the seventh year a sabbath of rest is to the land, a sabbath to Jehovah; your field you do not sow, and your vineyard you do not prune;
25.5: the spontaneous growth of your harvest you do not reap, and the grapes of your separated thing you do not gather, a year of rest it is to the land.
25.6: `And the sabbath of the land has been to you for food, to you, and to your man-servant, and to your handmaid, and to your hireling, and to your settler, who are sojourning with you;
25.7: and to your cattle, and to the beast which is in your land, is all your increase for food.
25.8: `And you have numbered to you seven sabbaths of years, seven years seven times, and the days of the seven sabbaths of years have been to you nine and forty years,
25.9: and you have caused a trumpet of shouting to pass over in the seventh month, in the tenth of the month; in the day of the atonements you do cause a trumpet to pass over through all your land;
25.10: and you have hallowed the year, the fiftieth year; and you have proclaimed liberty in the land to all its inhabitants; a jubilee it is to you; and you have turned back each to his possession; yes, each to his family you do turn back.
25.11: `A jubilee it is, the fiftieth year, a year it is to you; you sow not, nor reap its spontaneous growth, nor gather its separated things;
25.12: for a jubilee it is, holy it is to you; out of the field you eat its increase;
25.13: in the year of this jubilee you turn back each to his possession.
25.14: `And when you sell anything to your fellow, or buy from the hand of your fellow, you do not oppress one another;
25.15: by the number of years after the jubilee you do buy from your fellow; by the number of the years of increase he does sell to you;
25.16: according to the multitude of the years you do multiply its price, and according to the fewness of the years you do diminish its price; for a number of increases he is selling to you;
25.17: and you do not oppress one another, and you have been afraid of your God; for I am Jehovah your God.
25.18: `And you have done My statutes, and My judgments you keep, and have done them, and you have dwelt on the land confidently,
25.19: and the land has given its fruit, and you have eaten to satiety, and have dwelt confidently on it.
25.20: `And when you say, What do we eat in the seventh year, indeed, we do not sow, nor gather our increase?
25.21: then I have commanded My blessing on you in the sixth year, and it has made the increase for three years;
25.22: and you have sown the eighth year, and have eaten of the old increase; until the ninth year, until the coming in of its increase, you do eat the old.
25.23: `And the land is not sold--to extinction, for the land is Mine, for sojourners and settlers are you with Me;
25.24: and in all the land of your possession a redemption you do give to the land.
25.25: `When your brother becomes poor, and has sold his possession, then has his redeemer who is near to him come, and he has redeemed the sold thing of his brother;
25.26: and when a man has no redeemer, and his own hand has attained, and he has found as sufficient for its redemption,
25.27: then he has reckoned the years of its sale, and has given back that which is over to the man to whom he sold it, and he has returned to his possession.
25.28: `And if his hand has not found sufficiency to give back to him, then has his sold thing been in the hand of him who buys it till the year of jubilee; and it has gone out in the jubilee, and he has returned to his possession.
25.29: `And when a man sells a dwelling-house in a walled city, then has his right of redemption been until the completion of a year from its selling; days--is his right of redemption;
25.30: and if it is not redeemed until the fulness to him of a perfect year, then has the house which is in a walled city been established to extinction to the buyer of it, to his generations; it goes not out in the jubilee;
25.31: and a house of the villages which have no wall round about, on the field of the country is reckoned; redemption is to it, and in the jubilee it goes out.
25.32: `As to cities of the Levites--houses of the cities of their possession--redemption age-during is to the Levites;
25.33: as to him who redeems from the Levites, both the sale of a house and the city of his possession have gone out in the jubilee, for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession in the midst of the sons of Israel.
25.34: And a field, a suburb of their cities, is not sold; for a possession age-during it is to them.
25.35: `And when your brother is become poor, and his hand has failed with you, then you have kept hold on him, sojourner and settler, and he has lived with you;
25.36: you take no usury from him, or increase; and you have been afraid of your God; and your brother has lived with you;
25.37: your money you give not to him in usury, and for increase you give not your food;
25.38: I am Jehovah your God, who has brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give to you the land of Canaan, to become your God.
25.39: `And when your brother becomes poor with you, and he has been sold to you, you do not lay on him servile service;
25.40: as an hireling, as a settler, he is with you, till the year of the jubilee he does serve with you, --
25.41: then he has gone out from you, he and his sons with him, and has turned back to his family; even to the possession of his fathers he does turn back.
25.42: `For they are My servants, whom I have brought out from the land of Egypt: they are not sold with the sale of a servant;
25.43: you rule not over him with rigour, and you have been afraid of your God.
25.44: `And your man-servant and your handmaid whom you have are of the nations who are round about you; of them you buy man-servant and handmaid,
25.45: and also of the sons of the settlers who are sojourning with you, of them you buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have begotten in your land, and they have been to you for a possession;
25.46: and you have taken them for inheritance to your sons after you, to occupy for a possession; to the age you lay service upon them, but upon your brethren, the sons of Israel, one with another, you do not rule over him with rigour.
25.47: `And when the hand of a sojourner or settler with you attains riches, and your brother with him has become poor, and he has been sold to a sojourner, a settler with you, or to the root of the family of a sojourner,
25.48: after he has been sold, there is a right of redemption to him; one of his brethren does redeem him,
25.49: or his uncle, or a son of his uncle, does redeem him, or any of the relations of his flesh, of his family, does redeem him, or--his own hand has attained--then he has been redeemed.
25.50: `And he has reckoned with his buyer from the year of his being sold to him till the year of jubilee, and the money of his sale has been by the number of years; as the days of an hireling it is with him.
25.51: `If yet many years, according to them he gives back his redemption money, from the money of his purchase.
25.52: `And if few are left of the years till the year of jubilee, then he has reckoned with him, according to his years he does give back his redemption money;
25.53: as an hireling, year by year, he is with him, and he does not rule him with rigour before your eyes.
25.54: `And if he is not redeemed in these years, then he has gone out in the year of jubilee, he and his sons with him.
25.55: For to Me are the sons of Israel servants; My servants they are, whom I have brought out of the land of Egypt; I, Jehovah, am your God.

26.1: `You do not make to yourselves idols; and graven image or standing image you do not set up to yourselves; and a stone of imagery you do not put in your land, to bow yourselves to it; for I am Jehovah your God.
26.2: `My sabbaths you do keep, and My sanctuary you do reverence; I am Jehovah.
26.3: `If in My statutes you walk, and My commands you keep, and have done them,
26.4: then I have given your rains in their season, and the land has given her produce, and the tree of the field does give its fruit;
26.5: and reached to you has the threshing, the gathering, and the gathering does reach the sowing- time; and you have eaten your bread to satiety, and have dwelt confidently in your land.
26.6: `And I have given peace in the land, and you have lain down, and there is none causing trembling; and I have caused evil beasts to cease out of the land, and the sword does not pass over into your land.
26.7: `And you have pursued your enemies, and they have fallen before you by the sword;
26.8: and five of you have pursued a hundred, and a hundred of you do pursue a myriad; and your enemies have fallen before you by the sword.
26.9: `And I have turned to you, and have made you fruitful, and have multiplied you, and have established My covenant with you;
26.10: and you have eaten old store, and the old because of the new you bring out.
26.11: `And I have given My tabernacle in your midst, and My soul does not loathe you;
26.12: and I have walked habitually in your midst, and have become your God, and you--you are become My people;
26.13: I am Jehovah your God, who have brought you out of the land of the Egyptians, from being their servants; and I break the bars of your yoke, and cause you to go erect.
26.14: `And if you do not hearken to Me, and do not all these commands;
26.15: and if at My statutes you kick, and if My judgments your soul loathe, so as not to do all My commands--to your breaking My covenant--
26.16: I also do this to you, and I have appointed over you trouble, the consumption, and the burning fever, consuming eyes, and causing pain of soul; and your seed in vain you have sowed, and your enemies have eaten it;
26.17: and I have set My face against you, and you have been smitten before your enemies; and those hating you have ruled over you, and you have fled, and there is none pursuing you.
26.18: `And if to these you hearken not to Me, --then I have added to chastise you seven times for your sins;
26.19: and I have broken the pride of your strength, and have made your heavens as iron, and your earth as brass;
26.20: and consumed has been your strength in vain, and your land does not give her produce, and the tree of the land does not give its fruit.
26.21: `And if you walk with Me in opposition, and are not willing to hearken to Me, then I have added to you a plague seven times, according to your sins,
26.22: and sent against you the beast of the field, and it has bereaved you; and I have cut off your cattle, and have made you few, and your ways have been desolate.
26.23: `And if by these you are not instructed by Me, and have walked with Me in opposition,
26.24: then I have walked--I also--with you in opposition, and have smitten you, even I, seven times for your sins;
26.25: and I have brought in on you a sword, executing the vengeance of a covenant; and you have been gathered to your cities, and I have sent pestilence into your midst, and you have been given into the hand of an enemy.
26.26: `In My breaking to you the staff of bread, then ten women have baked your bread in one oven, and have given back your bread by weight; and you have eaten, and are not satisfied.
26.27: `And if for this you hearken not to Me, and have walked with Me in opposition,
26.28: then I have walked with you in the fury of opposition, and have chastised you, even I, seven times for your sins.
26.29: `And you have eaten the flesh of your sons; even flesh of your daughters you do eat.
26.30: And I have destroyed your high places, and cut down your images, and have put your carcases on the carcases of your idols, and My soul has loathed you;
26.31: and I have made your cities a waste, and have made desolate your sanctuaries, and I smell not at your sweet fragrances;
26.32: and I have made desolate the land, and your enemies, who are dwelling in it, have been astonished at it.
26.33: And you I scatter among nations, and have drawn out after you a sword, and your land has been a desolation, and your cities are a waste.
26.34: `Then does the land enjoy its sabbaths--all the days of the desolation, and you in the land of your enemies--then does the land rest, and has enjoyed its sabbaths;
26.35: all the days of the desolation it rests that which it has not rested in your sabbaths in your dwelling on it.
26.36: `And those who are left of you--I have also brought a faintness into their heart in the lands of their enemies, and the sound of a leaf driven away has pursued them, and they have fled--flight from a sword--and they have fallen, and there is none pursuing.
26.37: And they have stumbled one on another, as from the face of a sword, and there is none pursuing, and you have no standing before your enemies,
26.38: and you have perished among the nations, and the land of your enemies has consumed you.
26.39: `And those who are left of you--they consume away in their iniquity, in the lands of your enemies; and also in the iniquities of their fathers, with them they consume away.
26.40: `And--they have confessed their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they have trespassed against Me, and also, that they have walked with Me, in opposition,
26.41: also I walk to them in opposition, and have brought them into the land of their enemies--or then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and then they accept the punishment of their iniquity, --
26.42: then I have remembered My covenant with Jacob, and also My covenant with Isaac, and also My covenant with Abraham I remember, and the land I remember.
26.43: `And--the land is left of them, and does enjoy its sabbaths, in the desolation without them, and they accept the punishment of their iniquity, because, even because, against My judgments they have kicked, and My statutes has their soul loathed,
26.44: and also even this, in their being in the land of their enemies, I have not rejected them, nor have I loathed them, to consume them, to break My covenant with them; for I am Jehovah their God; --
26.45: then I have remembered for them the covenant of the ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt before the eyes of the nations to become their God; I am Jehovah.'
26.46: These are the statutes, and the judgments, and the laws, which Jehovah has given between Him and the sons of Israel, in mount Sinai, by the hand of Moses.

27.1: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
27.2: `Speak to the sons of Israel, and you have said to them, When a man makes a wonderful vow, by your valuation the persons are Jehovah's.
27.3: When your valuation has been of the male from a son of twenty years even to a son of sixty years, then has been your valuation fifty shekels of silver by the shekel of the sanctuary.
27.4: And if it is a female--then has your valuation been thirty shekels;
27.5: and if from a son of five years even to a son of twenty years--then has your valuation been of the male twenty shekels, and for the female, ten shekels;
27.6: and if from a son of a month even to a son of five years--then has your valuation been of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female your valuation is three shekels of silver;
27.7: and if from a son of sixty years and above--if a male, then has your valuation been fifteen shekels, and for a female, ten shekels.
27.8: `And if he is poorer than your valuation, then he has presented himself before the priest, and the priest has valued him; according to that which the hand of him who is vowing does reach does the priest value him.
27.9: `And if it is a beast of which they bring near an offering to Jehovah, all that one gives of it to Jehovah is holy;
27.10: he does not change it nor exchange it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good; and if he really change beast for beast, --then it has been--it and its exchange is holy.
27.11: `And if it is any unclean beast of which they do not bring near an offering to Jehovah, then he has presented the beast before the priest,
27.12: and the priest has valued it; whether good or bad, according to your valuation, O priest, so it is;
27.13: and if he really redeem it, then he has added its fifth to your valuation.
27.14: `And when a man sanctifies his house, a holy thing to Jehovah, then has the priest valued it, whether good or bad; as the priest does value it so it stands;
27.15: and if he who is sanctifying does redeem his house, then he has added a fifth of the money of your valuation to it, and it has become his.
27.16: `And if of the field of his possession a man sanctify to Jehovah, then has your valuation been according to its seed; a homer of barley-seed at fifty shekels of silver;
27.17: if from the year of the jubilee he sanctify his field, according to your valuation it stands;
27.18: and if after the jubilee he sanctify his field, then has the priest reckoned to him the money according to the years which are left, to the year of the jubilee, and it has been abated from your valuation.
27.19: `And if he really redeem the field--he who is sanctifying it--then he has added a fifth of the money of your valuation to it, and it has been established to him;
27.20: and if he do not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it is not redeemed any more;
27.21: and the field has been, in its going out in the jubilee, holy to Jehovah as a field which is devoted; to the priest is its possession.
27.22: `And if the field of his purchase (which is not of the fields of his possession) one sanctify to Jehovah--
27.23: then has the priest reckoned to him the amount of your valuation to the year of jubilee, and he has given your valuation in that day--a holy thing to Jehovah;
27.24: in the year of the jubilee the field returns to him from whom he bought it, to him whose is the possession of the land.
27.25: And all your valuation is by the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs is the shekel.
27.26: `Only, a firstling which is Jehovah's firstling among beasts--no man does sanctify it, whether ox or sheep; it is Jehovah's.
27.27: And if among the unclean beasts, then he has ransomed it at your valuation, and he has added its fifth to it; and if it is not redeemed, then it has been sold at your valuation.
27.28: `Only, no devoted thing which a man devotes to Jehovah, of all that he has, of man, and beast, and of the field of his possession, is sold or redeemed; every devoted thing is most holy to Jehovah.
27.29: `No devoted thing, which is devoted of man, is ransomed, it is surely put to death.
27.30: And all tithe of the land, of the seed of the land, of the fruit of the tree, is Jehovah's--holy to Jehovah.
27.31: `And if a man really redeem any of his tithe, its fifth he adds to it.
27.32: `And all the tithe of the herd and of the flock--all that passes by under the rod--the tenth is holy to Jehovah;
27.33: he enquires not between good and bad, nor does he change it; and if he really change it--then it has been--it and its exchange is holy; it is not redeemed.'
27.34: These are the commands which Jehovah has commanded Moses for the sons of Israel, in mount Sinai.
